Thanks to Stallamantic, Uncle Nicolini, rounderhouse, and anyone else who looked this over (sorry if I've forgotten you I forgot to keep a list this time).

This idea originally came from me positing what an "End-of-Cool" scenario would look like. After I realized it would be really hard to pull off in the SCP version of this, I changed my approach and eventually came up with this!
